D10.role: declared algebraic low-gauge and vacuum-coordinate recipe; threshold-complete SM unification is not claimed

anchors.endpoint_role: u=0,1 are limiting boundary values, not strictly positive two-anchor capacities
anchors.broader_anchor_hypothesis: Two differentiable strictly convex costs, each minimized at its own anchor, also place the unique minimizer between the anchors.
anchors.exponential_family_hypothesis: For one common regular one-parameter exponential family with psi''>0 and affine natural parameter theta(t), forward KL gives the same weighted log mean; reverse KL gives the mean in expectation coordinates, still between the anchors.

criticality.two_loop_root: lowest positive perturbative Yukawa root connected to the one-loop root

transport.one_loop: exact inverse-affine gauge paths and linear scalar equation for z=1/yt^2, evaluated by quadrature
transport.one_loop_crosscheck: separate DOP853 integration of the Yukawa equation
transport.two_loop: fully coupled SM gauge, top Yukawa and quartic equations; low gauge anchors held fixed by shooting

readout.physical_MSbar_identification: conditional on a finite matching map from v_chart to the renormalized electroweak vacuum; this map is not supplied

proof_contract.gauge_ratios: g3^2/g2^2>=1/2 between anchors; g3^2/gY^2>=1/2 between lower transport scale and E_cell
proof_contract.endpoint_sufficiency: Positive inverse-affine gauge paths have fractional-linear ratios with derivative of constant sign.
proof_contract.negative_beta_barrier: R=9*y^2/2-C<0 is backward-invariant: at R=0, R'=-C'>0; C'=k*(697*a^2/36-57*b^2/4-112*c^2)<0 when c>=a/2
proof_contract.mass_range: The unique self-scale top coordinate is strictly increasing in tb; all positive capacities therefore give the open interval between the two endpoint solutions.
proof_contract.proof_role: The mathematical argument accompanies these numerical hypothesis margins; tests of symbolic identities or sampled trajectories are not a formal proof of the theorem.

scope.standing: conditional top-coordinate range with equal-capacity premise removed

uncertainty: Endpoint digits, quadrature errors and solver tolerance differences diagnose numerical computation. Capacity dependence is not a confidence interval, loop shifts are not a theory-error bound, and physical matching uncertainty remains unquantified.
